title: The Longevity Ritual
subtitle: A glimpse of heaven through the flickering candlelight—

items.text: Stage, Ancient Zhu County
Around the noisy opera stage, bright fish and dragon lanterns surge and dive amidst the crowd, as if breaching out of a living ocean.
The festival is reaching its busiest hour.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: *sigh*

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Where should I go now? I'm all alone.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: So tired, so hungry. Not a wen to my name. Can't even buy myself a bun.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Where are they? Surely I'm not the only herbaceous Yao in town, am I?
Mayfly leans against a stone pillar at the Paifang and sits down as she looks out at the swirling crowd.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Well, even if you find no one, you'll manage. You're a reed, after all. You can take root anywhere, and let the earth feed you.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: But I'd prefer food. What time is it now?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: If I had known this would be so difficult, I'd have eaten more cakes while Heron was paying.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: At least then I wouldn't be here listening to my stomach growl.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: *sigh* If only I were an immortal. I'd never go hungry again. I'll bet their elixirs must taste better than any river water.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Hm? Why are people gathering around here?

items.speaker: Boy I
items.text: Mama! It's the iron flower fireworks! Can I see? Can I see?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Fireworks, gone in a moment.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: But so beautiful.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: If only my life had a moment like that, just one.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Yáng Wǔ, what are you smiling about?

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: The iron flower fireworks. So beautiful!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Dù Liù, Yáng Wǔ! Get your men into position! Keep your eyes on the stage!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: This is where the immortal will supposedly arrive to grant longevity. If something happens, I need you all at the ready!
Chéng Héguāng stands on an elevated platform, looking down over the happy fairgoers with an unmatching expression, too dark and serious against the joyful night.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: But the opera doesn't start for a while yet. What's wrong, Chief? You're looking more serious than ever.

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: A Daoist gave him the slip this afternoon.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: What? Who could escape Chief Chéng's leaf blades?

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: It was the lady who cast a spell at the gate, remember? Best keep an eye out for her.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Are these orders from you or Chief Chéng?

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: You asked the question, I answered. No need to be snide.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Enough. That Daoist possessed strange arcane skills, the likes of which I have never seen. I take the blame for her escape.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Her arrival coinciding with this mysterious sect is no coincidence. She's scheming something. Stay sharp!

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: You ever wonder why the chief's sword is never blunt? I figure it's because he's always yelling at it.

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: What are you talking about?

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: "Stay sharp! Stay sharp!"

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Pfft.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Dù Liù!

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Yes, Chief!
Their chief holds a stern face, but his cheeks betray him with a flush of red.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I wasn't talking to my sword.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Right, of course, Chief!

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Tsk tsk, can't believe you're spreading rumors like that.

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: I'd say that warrants a caning. Allow me to carry out the sentence.
Their chief grits his teeth, places a hand on his blade, and turns his back.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The opera will begin soon. I need everyone in position. No more jokes. If any suspect gets away, you'll face more than a caning.

items.speaker: Du Liu & Yang Wu
items.text: Understood!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Follow me, and keep your eyes and ears peeled! We must safeguard the civilians and apprehend any offenders!

items.speaker: Constables
items.text: Yes, Chief!
Night falls. Lanterns dot the river. More black-awning boats appear, each one festooned with candles.

items.speaker: Boy I
items.text: Mama, look! There's a little man dancing on the candle.

items.speaker: Ancient Woman I
items.text: Don't be silly. That's just the candlelight flickering.

items.speaker: Vendor II
items.text: Come and play pitch-pot! Young lady, dare to try your luck?

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Make way! Make way!

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Make way, please! We need to clear a path for the audience.

items.speaker: Vendor II
items.text: Of course, officer.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Is the opera about to begin?

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Yes, in just a few minutes.
Laughter and chatter close in as a group of men and women pass Yáng Wǔ.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Those are the Yao I met at the cake stall.

items.speaker: Hare
items.text: Come join us!
A parade of joyful Yao passes before Mayfly. They spin around until they seem like a carousel with her in the center, a parade with no beginning and no end.
Entranced by the sight, the procession sweeps Mayfly off her feet, carrying her away as if caught in the current of a flooding river.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Hey! No pushing! Over there! Keep the peace, or we'll keep it for you!

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Ugh! Eh ...
Mayfly looks back. She's been carried far only to be left in a strange place, sticking out like driftwood after a receding tide.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: The-The stage? How did I—?
The music rises fast and loud. An opera singer steps onto the stage with quick steps.
The singer's melodious voice captures the crowd in a sudden rapture.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: This is Legends of Handan!
The singing reaches the far end of the stage, where Chéng Héguāng and his men stand eyeing the proceedings suspiciously.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Legends of Handan? How could they choose this of all operas with these rumors going around?

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: What's it about, Chief?
Chéng's hard stare conveys his disdain even before his words confirm it.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It tells the story of a scholar who was guided into a dream by the immortal Lǚ Dòngbīn. There, he experienced life as an official in the imperial system; he found enlightenment once he awoke and became Lǚ's apprentice to pursue longevity.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Hah. No wonder you're so shook up over it.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I, eugh, I can't see.
Mayfly stands on her tiptoes, unable to see the stage over the crowd. But though she can't make out the scene, the song, at least, breaks through.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I must've watched this opera a hundred times.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: But I've never seen them use candles before. Did they change the story?
She finds her way to the front of the stage and looks up, captivated at the performance. It pulls the joy and hope of the crowd up like spun silk that gives warmth and color to the night sky.
Countless candles ring the stage. Their flickering flames throw dim, dancing shadows on the walls, shadows that seem to sway and bob like a procession of monks in prayer.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: It's so warm.

items.speaker: Fox
items.text: Goodness, how beautiful!

items.speaker: Hare
items.text: I can't keep myself from staring.
The flames leap out from their wax altars, speaking in a divine and wordless tongue to the people below.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Hold on. When did they light these candles?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: The flames, they're whispering something.
The small lights sway beneath the night sky, alternating between bright and dim. They become a hypnotic flow that those watching cannot turn away from.
The flickering lights seem to laugh, to scold, and then to chant unclear words, venting the pain of their brief lives through the ages.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Yes, I can hear them. They're saying ...

items.speaker: Fox
items.text: Grant us longevity.

items.speaker: Hare
items.text: Grant us longevity.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Wait. When did I get this close?
A hush falls over the crowd. Mayfly looks up at the figure on the stage.
The warm light shimmers. Hearts beat in time with the swaying shadows. This stage feels as if it were instead a refuge, a bastion of light and song calling out to those who might approach it.
Under the cover of night, under the gaze of many hundreds of eyes, a hundredfold stages rise.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Dù Liù! Yáng Wǔ! Where are you?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Ah. They're using the candlelight to conjure illusions! Avert your eyes!

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Only a fool would give up such a chance.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Do you wish to become immortal?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: He-Heron?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Heaven and earth bear the essence which forms all life. I shall live as long as the sun and the moon shine.
